progressions.text: While you're still a beginner, the game world is closed off from unnecessary complexity. [br/]At this stage, only the training mode with [color=#FFCC00]Uncle Slava[/color] is available to you. Don't rush—use this time to get familiar with the controls, master the core mechanics, and understand how to begin your journey on the server. Main jobs, factions, and gangster showdowns can wait for now.[br/][br/]Your first goal is to earn your starting capital. In the future, you'll be able to spend it on your first [color=#FFCC00]car[/color] from the dealership, buy a [color=#FFCC00]garage,[/color] an [color=#FFCC00]apartment[/color], or even your own [color=#FFCC00]house.[/color][br/][br/]And if you can't wait to get started as soon as possible, you can try beginner jobs: [color=#E0584B]Factory, Mine, and Farm.[/color] They do not require any additional conditions. You can find the right location using the [color=#E0584B]/gps[/color] command by setting a route to the selected job.

You've gotten somewhat settled in, and now the first opportunities for serious earnings and service are opening up before you. We recommend getting a [color=#85D359]medical card[/color] and a [color=#85D359]Category B license[/color] for driving vehicles in advance — they will come in handy when applying for many jobs. You can obtain a medical card at the [color=#FFCC00]central hospital[/color] of any city, and get your driver's license at the [color=#FFCC00]driving school.[/color] You can find the place you need using the [color=#E0584B]/gps[/color] command or by the markers on the map. If you run into any difficulties, [color=#FFCC00]Uncle Slava[/color] at the train station will give you all the guidance you need.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Jobs:[/color] [br/]You can try yourself in the service sector: become a [color=#E0584B]Bus Driver,[/color] a [color=#E0584B]Courier[/color] or get a job at a nightclub. A lot of suspicious business goes on there, but [color=#E0584B]Cooks[/color] and [color=#E0584B]Dancers[/color] are always needed. And keep in mind that entry to the club is paid — you'll have to pay and dress more decently.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Factions:[/color] [br/]Want to serve your Motherland? Now you can enlist in the [color=#E0584B]Army[/color] at the [color=#FFCC00]Military Commissariat[/color] and receive a military ID.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Tasks:[/color] [br/]Uncle Slava will continue your [color=#E0584B]Training[/color] and tell you what to do next.

This is the most important level on your path to success. This is exactly where the maximum number of new earning and career opportunities opens up. From this level, you can also purchase your own real estate — [color=#FFCC00]apartments[/color] and [color=#FFCC00]houses.[/color] You can buy them directly from the state or by participating in auctions.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Jobs:[/color] [br/]The choice has become even wider: catch and sell fish ([color=#E0584B]Fisherman[/color]), clean up the city ([color=#E0584B]Garbage Truck Driver[/color]), search for treasure ([color=#E0584B]Treasure Hunter[/color]), or earn your first capital as a [color=#E0584B]Taxi Driver[/color]. Also, they say [color=#E0584B]Car Thieves[/color] are paid pretty well too.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Factions:[/color] [br/]Now you can treat people ([color=#E0584B]City Hospital[/color]), go into politics ([color=#E0584B]Government[/color]), work for the special services ([color=#E0584B]FBI[/color]), broadcast on air ([color=#E0584B]Media[/color]), or join one of the local “football clubs.” Their representatives often hold recruitments and look for devoted fans with unusual talents.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Tasks:[/color] [br/]The [color=#E0584B]Storyline[/color] is now open to you. Complete Uncle Slava's tasks to learn more about the game world and collect valuable rewards.

If you dream of catching criminals or keeping order on the roads, your time has come. For your next steps, a [color=#85D359]weapon license[/color] will be useful; you can obtain it from the [color=#FFCC00]Government[/color].[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Jobs:[/color]  [br/]Become an [color=#E0584B]Auto Mechanic[/color] and repair cars, or gather meat and hides through [color=#E0584B]Hunting[/color] in the forest.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Factions:[/color]  [br/]Law enforcement agencies are available: [color=#E0584B]Traffic Police, City Police[/color] and [color=#E0584B]Penitentiary Service[/color], look for them in your navigator ([color=#FFCC00]/gps[/color]).[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Tasks:[/color] [br/]Uncle Slava has prepared additional [color=#E0584B]Quests[/color] for experienced players, so don't forget to stop by and see him from time to time.

Now you can be trusted with responsible work to improve the city's peaceful life.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Jobs:[/color] [br/]Become an [color=#E0584B]EMERCOM[/color] employee and put out fires, maintain the city's pipeline as a [color=#E0584B]Gas Worker[/color], or work as a [color=#E0584B]Pickup Point Courier[/color], delivering orders to customers.
[color=#FFCC00]Congratulations on leveling up![/color] [br/]Keep improving, and soon new activities and factions will become available to you.

Continue your career in logistics.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Jobs:[/color] [br/]Get a job as a [color=#E0584B]Warehouse Worker[/color]. Here you need to be attentive and quick while sorting cargo at the [color=#FFCC00]Nizhegorodsk Port[/color].

The city is constantly developing, and you can take part in it.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Jobs:[/color] [br/]Become a [color=#E0584B]Construction Worker[/color] at a building site, or take the controls of heavy machinery as an [color=#E0584B]Excavator Driver[/color].
[color=#FFCC00]Congratulations on leveling up![/color] [br/]Keep improving, and soon new activities and factions will become available to you.

One of the freest and most profitable professions becomes available right now.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Jobs:[/color]  [br/]Become a [color=#E0584B]Truck Driver[/color]. Load up your rig, turn on your favorite music, and conquer the highways while transporting valuable cargo.
[color=#FFCC00]Congratulations on leveling up![/color] [br/]Keep improving, and soon new activities and factions will become available to you.

A profitable technical position for specialists with skilled hands.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Jobs:[/color]  [br/]Now you can become an [color=#E0584B]Electrician[/color]. Restore power to homes and repair the district's electrical networks.
[color=#FFCC00]Congratulations on leveling up![/color] [br/]Keep improving, and soon new activities and factions will become available to you.
[color=#FFCC00]Congratulations on leveling up![/color] [br/]Keep improving, and soon new activities and factions will become available to you.

Your experience is already high enough to handle the most dangerous job — transporting cash.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Jobs:[/color]  [br/]Get a job as a [color=#E0584B]Cash Collector[/color] at any bank in the city. The work pays well, but the risk is high too — be ready to protect the valuable cargo from attack.
[color=#FFCC00]Congratulations on leveling up![/color] [br/]Keep improving, and soon new activities and factions will become available to you.
[color=#FFCC00]Congratulations on leveling up![/color] [br/]Keep improving, and soon new activities and factions will become available to you.

There are no more closed doors for you — now you can take on the most profitable work and complete tasks in the depths. For this, do not forget to get a [color=#85D359]watercraft operating license[/color] and a boat.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Jobs:[/color]  [br/]Descend to the bottom for treasures in the suit of a [color=#E0584B]Diver[/color]. Contact any [color=#FFCC00]Pier Captain[/color] and receive an assignment at the shipwreck site.

professions.text: Production of materials in the workshop. You need to take blanks, process them at the workstation, and turn in the finished products. [br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 1
Mining ore in the mine using a pickaxe. After extraction, the ore is delivered to the mine cart for further processing. [br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 1

The farm gives access to several types of jobs: [br/] [color=#E0584B] 1. Crop Collector [/color] — harvesting crops in the fields and greenhouses on the farm territory. The harvested crops must be delivered to the warehouse. [br/] [color=#E0584B] 2. Milker [/color] — collecting milk from cows with subsequent delivery to the warehouse. [br/] [color=#E0584B] 3. Beekeeper [/color] — collecting honey from beehives with subsequent delivery to the warehouse. First you need to rent a hive, and then take a frame with honey out of it. [br/] [color=#E0584B] 4. Combine Driver [/color] — harvesting crops from the fields using specialized machinery. You need to work the plots and collect agricultural crops. [br/] For easier movement around the farm, you can rent special transport. [br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 1 [br/] - Category C license (for the combine driver) [br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful commands:[/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/lock [/color] - open/close the combine door

You can get a job by invitation from the club owner for one of the following positions:[br/][color=#E0584B]Dancer[/color] — performances on the dance podium of the nightclub. The main task is to stay on the beat of the music and perform movement combinations. [br/][color=#E0584B]Cook[/color] — preparing dishes in the club kitchen. You need to choose available recipes, cook dishes step by step, and hand over completed orders.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 2[br/] - Up to 10,000 rubles (the entrance price is set by the club owner)[br/] - Any equipped skin except “Homeless Person“[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful commands:[/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/ncleave[/color] - leave the nightclub job[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Commands for nightclub owners:[/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/cemenu[/color] - nightclub owner menu

Transporting passengers along a set route with stops at marked points. You need to follow the route, stop for passenger boarding and disembarking, and continue along the route.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 2[br/] - Category D license[br/] - Must not be in a faction

Delivering orders from pickup points to clients using transport. You need to pick up orders and deliver them to the specified addresses. Order pickup and delivery locations are automatically marked on the map. [br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 2[br/] - Must not be in a faction

Catching fish in available zones on the map using a fishing rod. To start, a fisherman needs to purchase [color=#85D359]fishing rods, bait, and tackle[/color] — their quality determines access to more productive fishing zones and catch efficiency.[br/] After buying everything necessary, you need to find a suitable Fishing Zone. [br/] After a successful fishing trip, you need to return to the [color=#FFCC00]Fishing Shop[/color] and talk to the [color=#FFCC00]Fish Buyer[/color] to sell your catch.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 3[br/] - Fishing rod required (can be bought at any Fishing Shop)

Collecting and removing garbage from container sites using specialized transport. You need to pick up waste, load it into the garbage truck, and deliver it to the landfill for unloading.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 3[br/] - Category C license[br/] - Lawfulness no lower than -10[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful commands: [/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/tlist[/color] - shows all garbage containers available for interaction, their fill level, and the distance to the player

Searching for hidden treasures in the marked zone. You need to explore the area and find stashes within a limited time.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 3[br/] - Shovel (can be bought at any 24/7 Store)[br/] - Metal detector (can be bought at any 24/7 Store)[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful commands: [/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/kleave[/color] - leave the job[br/][color=#E0584B]/dig[/color] - dig the ground

Searching for, breaking into, and delivering vehicles to the specified point. You need to find a car in the designated area, break into it, and deliver it to the drop-off point.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 3[br/] - Category B license[br/] - Lockpick set (can be bought at any 24/7 Store)[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful commands: [/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/carjack[/color] - start breaking into a car[br/][color=#E0584B]/scarjack[/color] - stop breaking into a car

Work as a taxi driver in one of the taxi companies. Each taxi company pays its own salary. You can work only in the [color=#FFCC00]company[/color] where you are officially employed.[br/]Transporting passengers and delivering orders using a company or personal vehicle. The job includes accepting orders, arriving to the client, and delivering them to the specified point, as well as completing goods delivery assignments.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 3[br/] - Category B license[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful commands: [/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/tc[/color] - taxi company internal chat[br/][color=#E0584B]/tord[/color] - list of orders in the taxi company[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Commands for taxi company owners: [/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/tmenu[/color] - taxi company management menu[br/][color=#E0584B]/tuninvite[/color] (player ID) - dismiss a taxi company employee[br/][color=#E0584B]/trank[/color] (player ID) - change an employee's rank in the taxi company

Tracking and hunting wild animals in hunting zones. You need to use bait, obtain trophies, and deliver them for sale or further processing.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 4[br/] - Weapon license [br/] - Rifle and ammunition (can be bought at any Weapon Store)[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful commands: [/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/hleave[/color] - finish hunting

Vehicle repair and refueling services. You need to interact with cars by servicing them and setting the price for the provided services.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 4[br/] - Category B license[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful commands: [/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/joblist[/color] - list of available calls[br/][color=#E0584B]/getfuel[/color] (amount in liters) - buy fuel at a gas station[br/][color=#E0584B]/find[/color] - workers online[br/][color=#E0584B]/fill[/color] (player id) (fuel amount) (price) - refuel a car[br/][color=#E0584B]/repair[/color] (player id) (price) - repair a car

Trips to sites for diagnostics and repair of gas equipment within a limited time. You must identify malfunctions, perform maintenance, and complete tasks before the contract expires.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Device requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 5[br/] - Category B driver's license[br/] - Lawfulness of at least 50[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful commands: [/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/contract[/color] - list of available orders[br/][color=#E0584B]/findgas[/color] - change the repair sequence of gas substations

Responding to emergencies and eliminating their consequences. You need to use specialized equipment to extinguish fires, clear blockages, and force open obstacles while completing tasks with trips to locations.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 5[br/] - Category D license[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful commands: [/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/meslist[/color] - order list (available only in a vehicle)[br/][color=#E0584B]/mesinv[/color] (player id) - invite a player to the team[br/][color=#E0584B]/mesleave[/color] - disband the team

Delivering goods along a pre-planned route. You need to pick up the cargo, load it into transport, and deliver it to the specified addresses, handing it over to recipients. The job can be done alone or [color=#FFCC00]as part of a group[/color], which makes it possible to handle tasks more efficiently. You can invite a player to a group through the radial menu.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 5[br/] - Category B license[br/] - Lawfulness no lower than -50

Receiving, checking, and placing goods in the warehouse. You need to scan cargo, verify it against the assignment sheet, and distribute it to the appropriate sectors, and the work can be performed together with a partner for greater efficiency. [br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 7[br/] - Lawfulness no lower than -50

To get hired by a construction company, you need to submit an application through the foreman. Admission to the company is handled by the deputy or the director.[br/]Construction companies provide access to several types of jobs:[br/][color=#E0584B]1. Construction Worker[/color] — performs the main tasks on the site. This position includes carrying cement, repairing pipes, repairing wiring, and taking out trash.[br/][color=#E0584B]2. Excavator Driver[/color] — performs ground work on the construction site. This job is available only at high-class construction sites. To get hired, you need to have a [color=#85D359]Category C license[/color] and [color=#85D359]500 skill[/color] in the construction worker job.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 8 [br/] - Category C license (for the excavator driver)[br/] - Construction worker skill 500 (for the excavator driver)[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful commands: [/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/bcompany[/color] - main company menu[br/][color=#E0584B]/bc[/color] - construction company chat

Delivering cargo between remote points along assigned routes. You need to pick up the cargo, deliver it along the route, and unload it at the destination point. The job requires long trips and monitoring the condition of the cargo.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 10[br/] - Category C license[br/] - Medical card[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful commands: [/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/lock[/color] - get into the truck[br/][color=#E0584B]/cargo[/color] - trailer rental

Maintaining and restoring the city's power grid. You need to travel to locations, interact with equipment, and perform diagnostics and repair work on various infrastructure facilities.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 12[br/] - Category B license[br/] - Lawfulness no lower than -50[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful commands: [/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/elist[/color] - list of available calls

Collector — a bank employee engaged in the transportation of money and other valuables for the needs of the bank or its clients.  This job is [color=#FFCC00]team-based[/color]; you can only work it together with a partner. You can invite a player to a group through the radial menu.[br/][br/]Partner roles:[br/][color=#E0584B]1. Driver[/color] — the team member who rented the vehicle. Never leaves the vehicle, monitors the situation, and in case of danger can call for help via the [color=#FFCC00]panic button[/color] in the cash-in-transit vehicle. [br/][color=#E0584B]2. Collector[/color] — the team member acting as a passenger in the vehicle and as the collector outside it. Directly interacts with the valuable cargo and is responsible for its safety. [br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 15[br/] - Category C license[br/] - Weapon license[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful commands: [/color][br/][color=#E0584B]/cmenu[/color] - collector personal card[br/][color=#E0584B]/collist[/color] - list of collectors online[br/][color=#E0584B]/ic[/color] - collectors chat[br/][color=#E0584B]/colinv[/color] (player id) - invite a player as a partner[br/][color=#E0584B]/blist[/color] - list of money transport orders

Searching for and recovering valuable items from the bottoms of bodies of water using a rented boat and equipment. The job takes place in dive cycles at designated points. After collecting artifacts from sunken objects and their surroundings, the loot is delivered for sale to the [color=#FFCC00]Pier Captain[/color].[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Employment requirements: [/color][br/] - Level 18[br/] - Watercraft license

help.text: [color=#E0584B]GRAND HORIZON RP [/color]is a mobile game with a map of Russia.[br/]An interesting game mode: a storyline, many exciting professions and jobs, a family system, and eleven different organizations.[br/]New 3D interiors and buildings for complete immersion in the game world.[br/] [br/]About 100 unique cars, from domestic classics to premium supercars.[br/] [br/]We have developed a large number of truly cool skins that you will be able to purchase in clothing stores.[br/]Play on our servers anywhere, no matter where you are!

The [color=#E0584B]Grand Horizon RP [/color]administration strongly asks you not to share your data with third parties, namely: passwords and email addresses.[br/] [br/] Do not use the same [color=#85D359]login/password [/color]on other gaming projects. Do not install suspicious programs on your devices.[br/]And remember: the [color=#E0584B]Grand Horizon RP [/color]administration never asks players for their passwords.

By playing on our server, every hour [color=#85D359](PayDay) [/color]you will receive experience points [color=#85D359](Exp). [/color]Once you accumulate the required amount, you will increase your character's level.[br/][br/]Each increase in your game level will unlock new [color=#FFCC00]jobs and opportunities [/color]for you, allowing your character to develop faster.[br/]To view your personal statistics, click on the game chat and enter the command [color=#0099CC]/mm[br/] [br/][/color]It will allow you to familiarize yourself with all the main commands on the server, change settings, or ask the administration of [color=#E0584B]Grand Horizon RP[br/][/color]a question you are interested in.

Immediately after registering an account, the main game features will be available to you: [br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Completing tasks[/color][br/]Uncle Slava will give valuable advice and the first assignments to make it easier for you to get used to the game. You can find him at any train station. [br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Jobs for beginners[/color][br/]From the start, three main jobs are available: [color=#0099CC]miner, factory parts assembler, farmer.[br/][/color]Each job has its own specifics. To choose the one you will truly like, we recommend trying them all.[br/] [br/]All workplaces can be found using your GPS. To do this, simply enter [color=#0099CC]/gps — jobs for beginners.[br/][/color]Use the appropriate bus to get to the required location.[br/] [br/]As soon as you earn the required amount of money, head to the [color=#0099CC]Driving School[/color] and get a driver's license.[br/] [br/]The exam price is [color=#85D359]2500 rubles.[br/][/color]Before taking it, be sure to study everything offered at the driving school, as this will help avoid additional retake costs.[br/] [br/]After getting your license and leveling up, you will be able to move on to [color=#85D359]main jobs[/color].

[color=#85D359]Role Play (RP) [/color]is a game in which a participant takes on a role and, in any game situation, acts according to that role on behalf of the chosen character, guided by the character's personality and the internal logic of the environment, rather than by an external behavior script.[br/] [br/]That means how events develop in the game world depends precisely on the actions of the players. And the gameplay process itself is a simulation of one situation or another by a group of people.[br/] [br/]RP behavior is considered an important part of the gameplay and is supported by the administration as a way for players to communicate with each other.

The entire in-game life of characters takes place under the control of the [color=#FFCC00]Government[/color] – the main governing organization.[br/] [br/]The Government is located in the center of the city of Nizhegorodsk and is headed by the Regional Governor. It is here that you will be able to obtain [color=#85D359]licenses[/color] for weapons or vehicle operation, as well as register your [color=#FFCC00]Family[/color].[br/]Political life in [color=#E0584B]Grand Horizon RP [/color]is extraordinarily rich and exciting. You will personally see this from your very first days with us!

There are two main chats available on the server:[br/][color=#E0584B]In Character (IC) [/color]— a chat in which the game characters themselves communicate. This chat is the main one; it is where the [color=#FFCC00]Role Play [/color]mode is played out.[br/] [br/][color=#85D359]Out Of Character (OOC) [/color]— everything related to the real world rather than the game world can be discussed in this chat. To do this, use the command [color=#0099CC]/n[/color]. It will highlight your message with double parentheses [color=#0099CC](( ))[/color].[br/] [br/]In addition, you can use a mobile phone.[br/]After joining an organization, additional chats [color=#0099CC]/r[/color] or [color=#0099CC]/f[/color] will become available to you.[br/] [br/]The Media organization additionally has the ability to conduct public broadcasts.[br/]All organization chats are roleplay [color=#E0584B](In Character (IC)).[br/][/color]

There are many [color=#FFCC00]residential houses[/color] and [color=#FFCC00]apartments[/color] available for purchase in the region.[br/]The cost of each specific property depends on many factors. You can buy a small cozy apartment for modest money or spend millions on a luxurious mansion in a prestigious area.[br/] [br/]If you own a private house, you can store your personal vehicle in your own [color=#FFCC00]garage[/color]. In addition, you can purchase various improvements for your home. For example, [color=#FFCC00]automatic doors[/color] or a [color=#FFCC00]wardrobe[/color], which will allow you to change your appearance and store clothes.[br/]Owning a private house also allows you to install [color=#FFCC00]Workbenches[/color] and grow [color=#FFCC00]Medicinal Herbs[/color]. This is only a small part of all the advantages and possibilities of owning your own home.[br/] [br/]Depending on the prestige of the property, you will be charged a daily utility fee [color=#E0584B](rent)[/color].[br/]You can pay rent in advance at any nearby [color=#FFCC00]Bank[/color]. [br/]Remember that if the rent is not paid, your property will be sold, and all property stored in it will be [color=#E0584B]confiscated[/color]!

The project has a developed transport infrastructure, thanks to which you will be able to quickly move between cities or carry out cargo transportation.[br/] [br/]The first type of transport you will encounter is [color=#85D359]buses[/color]. With their help, you can get to the main places on the map. Routes are intelligently laid out through all key jobs and organizations.[br/]All that remains is for you to choose the required route.[br/] [br/]The second public transport type is [color=#85D359]Taxi[/color].[br/]You can use the services of one of three taxi companies competing with each other.[br/] [br/][color=#85D359]Cargo transportation. [/color] The region always needs new drivers to carry out long-distance cargo transportation. Thanks to them, private businesses and large enterprises are restocked with goods.[br/] [br/][color=#85D359]Your own car. [/color] You can purchase it at a car dealership. With the help of the navigator [color=#0099CC](/gps — Car Dealerships)[/color], you will find the vehicle best suited to your personal needs in terms of price and characteristics. If you are in doubt, you can take any model for a test drive and try it out in action.[br/]Initially, [color=#FFCC00]1 slot[/color] for a car is available to each player; later, you will be able to increase the number of cars you can purchase. Your own vehicle has wear and mileage, which are taken into account when selling and affect the price. In addition, every car is subject to registration with the [color=#0099CC]Traffic Police.[/color]

Any vehicle consists of components.[br/]During use, they [color=#FFC700]wear out[/color] and, as a result, deteriorate.[br/][br/]To keep a car in good condition, it is necessary to regularly undergo [color=#FFC700]diagnostics[/color] at the Service Station.[br/]Wear of car parts depends on the distance traveled and the number of accidents.[br/]If the parts of your car have become unusable, they must be replaced at the Service Station ([color=#0099CC]/gps - Service Stations and tuning studios[color/]).

Every player gets their own personal [color=#FFCC00]account[/color] at the bank. All income is credited to it: salary, rewards, etc. This account is called the main account and is available at any [color=#FFCC00]ATM[/color].[br/]In addition, at the ATM you can pay [color=#0099CC]fines[/color] and transfer money to [color=#0099CC]charity[/color].[br/] [br/]Bank branches offer any account servicing services: you may open up to 8 additional accounts or transfer money to another player's account. Additional accounts can be customized, protected with a PIN code, renamed, and used to view a detailed transaction history.[br/] [br/][color=#FFCC00]Rent for a house, garage[/color] or [color=#FFCC00]personal business[/color] is also paid at banks.

A large number of organizations operate in the game.[br/]They can be state organizations ([color=#85D359]Government, Traffic Police, City Police, FBI, City Hospital, Media, Military Unit, Penitentiary Service[/color]) or criminal ([color=#E0584B]OCGs[/color]).[br/] [br/]Upon reaching a certain game level, you can join any organization you want. Some of them have additional entry requirements.[br/]For example, to get into an OCG, you will have to demonstrate your weapon handling skills. And if you see yourself as an ad editor, you need to have a good command of grammar and written language.[br/]You will be informed about additional criteria by the organization's leadership during recruitment.[br/] [br/]After joining, career advancement will become available to you.[br/]With each increase in [color=#FFCC00]rank[/color], your salary and social status in the organization will increase.[br/]You will find new friends, and over time you may take one of the leadership positions.[br/]Life in an organization is incredibly interesting and exciting.

[color=#FFC700]Lawfulness rating [/color]is a rating that is formed based on negative actions (kills). Every unjustified kill takes away [color=#FFC700]5 lawfulness points. [/color]For example, killing over a road accident, guarding a family mansion, and in other situations where such an extreme measure is not justified by the gameplay (RP) and is excessive.[br/] [br/]Of course, we fully understand that some kills are committed for a valid reason — for them, lawfulness [color=#FFC700]will not decrease. [/color]Such kills include: kills by law enforcement agencies, kills on Military Unit territory (including if an OCG member kills a soldier), kills during a cash-in-transit robbery, kills in a business war, kills at a family airdrop or family battle, kills at an event, or kills during a bank robbery.[br/] [br/]You can increase lawfulness by receiving [color=#FFC700]PayDay [/color]in the hourly payout window ([color=#0099CC]XX:00-XX:10[/color]). For each hour, players receive [color=#FFC700]1 point[br/][/color]of lawfulness (players with a VIP account receive 2 points), and lawfulness can also be purchased in the donation shop.[br/] [br/]It should be understood that players with a [color=#FFC700]low lawfulness rating[br/][/color]receive a number of restrictions or prohibitions:[br/][color=#FFC700] - [/color]Players with a low lawfulness rating (-70) will not be able to purchase a weapon license.[br/][color=#FFC700] - [/color]Players with low lawfulness (-50) will be treated longer and at a higher cost in the hospital.[br/][color=#FFC700] - [/color]Players with low lawfulness (-125) will not be able to join a state organization.[br/][color=#FFC700] - [/color]Players with low lawfulness (less than 0) will not be able to work side jobs, including truck driver and cash-in-transit collector.[br/][color=#FFC700] - [/color]Players with low lawfulness (-75 and below) will have an increased fee when making payments.[br/][color=#FFC700] - [/color]Players with low lawfulness (-100 and below) will have a higher property payment cost.[br/][color=#FFC700] - [/color]Players with low lawfulness (-150 and below) will have a higher cost for paying traffic fines.[br/][color=#FFC700] - [/color]Players with low lawfulness (-500) will have their weapon license automatically revoked.[br/] [br/]Also, if a player was punished by administrators for a kill, they are prohibited from [color=#FFC700]using and purchasing weapons [/color]for 24 hours after the punishment is issued.[br/] [br/]We hope for your understanding and are ready to accept any suggestions for changing the system in order to rid our project of a high level of aggression.

Weapons are dangerous tools, and their use is strictly controlled.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Obtaining a license[/color][br/]To use weapons, you must obtain a [color=#85D359]License[/color] from the Government. This is possible at [color=#0099CC]level 4+[/color] and with no less than [color=#0099CC]-70 lawfulness[/color]. Only after receiving permission will you be able to purchase ammunition in the [color=#FFCC00]ammo store[/color].[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Using weapons[/color][br/]Each weapon has its own type ([color=#0099CC]Melee, Primary, Secondary[/color]). Equip the weapon in the appropriate inventory slot, buy ammunition, and good luck in battle!

You have the opportunity to open your own business and earn large sums of money.[br/]It can be a [color=#85D359]gas station[/color], [color=#85D359]car dealership[/color], [color=#85D359]clothing store [/color]or even a[color=#85D359] gun store[/color], [color=#85D359]snack bar [/color]and [color=#85D359]24/7 store[/color]! Any type of business is available to you.[br/] [br/]With the appearance of a business, great prospects open up before you for attracting new customers, which means new sources of income.[br/]You will be able to regulate prices, improve various characteristics of your business, and compete with rivals at the same time.[br/] [br/]Do not forget that running a business requires constant attention: paying [color=#FFCC00]rent[/color] and completing tasks from the [color=#FFCC00]Entrepreneurship Center[/color].

The list of available jobs expands as you level up. Each profession has its own employment requirements, which can be found in the relevant information section ([color=#FFCC00]Professions[/color]). General requirement: you cannot be in an organization and employed at a job at the same time.[br/] [br/]In addition to a main job, there are side jobs. These include:[br/][color=#85D359]mine[/color], [color=#85D359]factory [/color]and [color=#85D359]farm[/color]. Such side jobs can be combined with main jobs, thereby increasing your income. Use the command [color=#0099CC]/gps [/color]to find the location of side jobs.[br/]You will learn all details and instructions for the side job on site.

With crafting, players can create items using found or obtained [color=#FFCC00]components.[/color] You can produce unique vehicles, skins, accessories, consumable items, and more expensive components.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Components[/color][br/]Crafting components can be obtained in different ways: at [color=#85D359]jobs,[/color] while [color=#85D359]exploring the world,[/color] received for completing [color=#85D359]tasks,[/color] bought from other players through the [color=#85D359]marketplace[/color] or taken from [color=#85D359]cases.[/color][br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Different components are obtained in different places:[/color][br/]- Mine — bauxite, iron ore[br/]- Factory — scrap metal, radio components[br/]- Farm — wood, textile fiber[br/]- Garbage truck driver — rubber scraps, plastic bottles, reagents[br/]- Treasure hunter — scrap metal, rubber scraps, plastic bottles[br/]- Hunting — animal hides[br/]- Fishing — rubber scraps, plastic bottles[br/]Try different activities and earning methods to collect the resources needed for crafting.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Workbench[/color][br/]A [color=#FFCC00]workbench[/color] is required to create items. Workbenches can be personal (installed in a house basement) or shared (in workshops).[br/][br/]To create rarer items, you will need:[br/]- A higher production skill level[br/]- A workbench of the appropriate level[br/][br/]Higher-level workbenches allow you to create not only items of their own class, but also all lower classes. [color=#FFCC00]Increase your production skill and upgrade your workbench[/color] to gain access to creating rarer and more valuable items![br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Item crafting[/color][br/]All created items have their own [color=#FFCC00]class.[/color] The class determines the item's value, rarity, and crafting difficulty.[br/][br/]All items have [color=#FFCC00]production parameters:[/color] creation time, chance of successful crafting, list of required components, production cost.[br/][br/]Special [color=#FFCC00]instructions[/color] will also be required to create items. They can be purchased from [color=#FFCC00]Kulibych[/color] in workshops. All instructions are distributed among different workshops, and their assortment is updated daily. If a certain instruction is urgently needed, use the search — Kulibych will tell you which workshop currently has it available.

Families are a clan-based social system. Those who know that any goal is achievable together with friends gather into a family. Here you will be able to complete [color=#FFCC00]tasks[/color], [color=#FFCC00]fight[/color], and [color=#FFCC00]capture territories[/color] together.[br/][br/]Various activities are available to families:[br/][color=#E0584B]Family Battle[/color] — the main PvP event for families. By placing a rating bet, teams participate in a shootout and fight for the entire pot. You can find the location of the Family Battle in [color=#0099CC]/gps — Important Places — Family War[/color].[br/][color=#E0584B]Territory captures (caps)[/color] — regular events held on the server every day. Families clash at locations in different corners of the region, and the winner of the shootout receives cash prizes and family rating points.[br/][br/]A family can be created in the [color=#FFCC00]Government[/color] building. In doing so, the player sets the family name and pays the registration cost. The family head or trusted members with the appropriate permissions can invite players to the family.⁠[br/]Players in the same family receive a shared chat, ranks, storage, a vehicle fleet, family tasks, a shop, a rating, and access to family PvP activities.⁠

If you have free time and the desire, we recommend visiting our entertainment activities:[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Events from the administration[/color][br/]Every day, the project administration holds events for players with cash prizes — keep an eye on the chat so you do not miss your chance to have fun and earn some cash.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Casino[/color][br/]For gambling players, the doors of the Casino are always open: here you will find all the traditional activities (games of [color=#85D359]BlackJack, roulette, and dice[/color]), as well as a way to get a job as a [color=#E0584B]Manager[/color] or [color=#E0584B]Croupier[/color].[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Container Battle[/color][br/]In Arzamas ([color=#0099CC]/gps — Entertainment — Container Battle[/color]), auctions for the contents of containers are held every day — if you want to test your luck and compete for special rewards, watch the chat announcements.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Computer Club[/color][br/]The best place for fun together is the Computer Club! Choose one of the mini-games and invite your friends! The winner's reward will be the cash bet placed before the match starts.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Nightclub[/color][br/]For lovers of music and parties, the Club is open around the clock: here you will find new ways to earn money (the job of [color=#E0584B]Cook[/color]) and a place to relax with friends.

Radio stations with music for every taste operate in the game. The easiest way to turn on the radio is the receiver icon button in the [color=#FFC700]car[/color]. For personal music listening, you need to buy [color=#FFC700]headphones[/color] or a [color=#FFC700]speaker[/color] in a 24/7 store. [br/][br/]To turn on music, open your inventory, select the playback device, and press "Use".

At the [color=#FFCC00]Auction[/color], players bid on the most valuable property: real estate, businesses, etc.[br/][br/]To put something up for auction, go to the special [color=#FFC700]'Sale'[/color] tab, where you choose the type and item you want to sell, set its price, and write a short description. After the bidding ends, the property will be transferred to the new owner, and you will receive the money.[br/]To remove an item previously listed on the auction, you need to go to the [color=#FFC700]'Mine'[/color] section, and then to the special [color=#FFC700]'Sale'[/color] tab.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Marketplace[/color] is needed for selling small property: accessories, skins, and crafted items. You do not need to come to the place of sale for it, as it is available directly from the [color=#0099CC]Tablet[/color]. Go to the marketplace menu, choose an item from your inventory, and set a price — after the purchase, you will receive an automatic message in the tablet.

[color=#FFC700]Initiatives[/color] are collective tasks for the entire faction.[br/]The leader sets the minimum rank, start time, and difficulty level.[br/]The higher the difficulty, the harder it is to meet the conditions and the more participants are required, but the rewards are also noticeably more valuable.[br/] [br/]Any employee who contributed receives a guaranteed reward.[br/]The best players in the initiative ranking are rewarded additionally.[br/]This way, the system encourages both mass participation and personal activity.[br/] [br/]The interface is divided into tabs: [color=#85D359]Goals[/color], [color=#85D359]Results[/color], [color=#85D359]Leaderboard[/color], and [color=#85D359]Information[/color].[br/]- In "Goals" you can see what needs to be completed.[br/]- In "Results" — the overall progress and personal contribution.[br/]- "Leaderboard" shows the top participants.[br/]To join, select an initiative and press [color=#85D359]"Participate"[/color]. The timer at the top shows how much time is left until completion.[br/] [br/]Performance is calculated as the average value of the last ten initiatives.[br/]The higher it is, the greater the [color=#E0584B]PayDay[/color] and the faction's income from quests.[br/]Each participation increases this indicator, even if the contribution is small.[br/]Therefore, regular participation is important both for personal benefit and for the whole team.

[color=#E0584B]Duel[/color] is an honest 1-on-1 fight for players who have reached [color=#85D359]level 4[/color]. Opponents can choose the weapon, location, and bet to find out which of them is the better shooter.[br/]Command to challenge to a duel: [color=#E0584B]/duel player id [/color]. For a successful challenge, players must stand no farther than 10 meters from each other.[br/]Duels can be rated, classic, and training. [br/][color=#85D359]Rated[/color] duels are held for a limited period of time. Those who collect more rating points get into the top rankings and receive valuable prizes at the end of the event. [br/][color=#85D359]Classic duels[/color] are available at all times. The bet for them is the players' money — the winner takes the entire pot. [br/][color=#85D359]Training fights[/color] are also available without restrictions, and no bets are accepted in them — only weapons and an opponent, nothing extra. [br/][br/]Using the command [color=#E0584B]/invduel player id [/color], opponents can invite witnesses with them to the duel. [br/]They are forbidden from interfering in the course of the fight; they may only observe and offer support.

[color=#FFCC00]PayDay[/color] is a system of regular payouts that a player receives for active play. To receive PayDay, you need to play a total of 20 minutes within one hour (for example, from 12:00 to 13:00). You do not have to play continuously — the time accumulates. Every hour (at 00 minutes), a new accumulation cycle begins. To receive the payout, you need to log into the game within 10 minutes after the start of the new hour. Only active play counts — idle time (AFK) may not count toward receiving the payout! [br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]What PayDay gives:[/color][br/]- Experience (EXP) [br/]- Lawfulness — 1 point (2 points for players with a VIP account) [br/]- Salary — if the player works in a faction and is at the workplace at the moment of receiving PayDay (the higher the faction's effectiveness, the greater the income) [br/]- Warehouses are also replenished during PayDay [br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Useful to know:[/color][br/]You can check the time using the command [color=#E0584B]/time[/color][br/]Watch the chat tips and pop-up notifications — they will tell you how much time is left until PayDay and when the reward can be collected.

The Storm Cup is a regular [color=#FFCC00]racing event[/color] where you take part in races, earn experience points, and progress toward valuable rewards.[br/][br/]Choose a suitable race through the Tablet and show your skill on the city streets! Please note that the car must meet the [color=#FFCC00]rank[/color] requirements — you can use either your own car or one offered automatically.[br/][br/]Every week, the vehicle rank in races is updated and the internal [color=#FFCC00]store[/color] of the Storm Cup is replenished, and at the end of the season, the very best receive valuable [color=#FFCC00]prizes[/color] and unique vehicles.

businesses.text: [color=#FFC700]24/7 Store[/color] is one of the main types of business in the game. Through stores, players sell general-demand goods to other players while earning money.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Store commands:[br/][/color][color=#E0584B]/business [/color]- Business information[br/][color=#E0584B]/sellbiz [/color]- Sell the business to the state[br/][color=#E0584B]/bizmusic [/color]- Sound when entering the business[br/]

[color=#FFC700]Gas Station [/color][color=#888888](automobile filling station) [/color]is a special, highly profitable type of business. Through a gas station, players refuel other players' vehicles while earning money. [br/]For stable gas station operation, it is necessary to regularly sign contracts with the fuel delivery service. A player can own a regular business and a gas station at the same time.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Gas station commands:[br/][/color][color=#E0584B]/fuelst [/color]- Gas station information[br/][color=#E0584B]/buyfuelst [/color]- Buy a gas station[br/][color=#E0584B]/sellfuelst [/color]- Sell the gas station to the state[br/]

[color=#FFC700]Nightclub[/color] is an excellent place for entertainment and pleasant leisure. It is located at [color=#0099CC]/gps — Entertainment[/color]. Anyone who passes [color=#FFC700]face control[/color] can get in (your clothes must not be standard).[br/][br/]In the nightclub, players have access to [color=#FFC700]dance battles, a bar, a VIP lounge[/color] and much more.[br/] [br/]The nightclub owner can fully manage their club and hire [color=#FFC700]dancers or cooks[/color].[br/] [br/][color=#FFC700]Dancer[/color] — dances on the podium in the nightclub. She has 3 levels, which determine the salary.[br/][color=#FFC700]Cook[/color] — prepares food in the kitchen. Cooks also have 3 levels, which determine their salary.[br/] [br/]You can learn all the details directly in the [color=#FFC700]nightclub[/color].[br/][br/][color=#FFC700]Nightclub commands:[br/][/color][color=#E0584B]/cemenu[/color] - Nightclub owner menu[br/][color=#E0584B]/ncleave[/color] - Quit the nightclub job[br/][color=#E0584B]/exitvip[/color] - End VIP room rental

[color=#FFC700]Casino[/color] is one of the most profitable types of business in the game. Moreover, characters can not only participate in games as establishment customers, but also get a job here as a [color=#E0584B]Manager[/color] or [color=#E0584B]Croupier[/color].[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Business commands:[br/][/color][color=#E0584B]/business [/color]- Business information[br/][color=#E0584B]/sellbiz [/color]- Sell the business to the state[br/][color=#E0584B]/bizmusic [/color]- Sound when entering the business[br/][color=#E0584B]/manager[/color] - Staff management menu (for the manager)

At [color=#FFC700]auto repair shops[/color], players perform tuning and maintenance of their vehicles. There are several stations in the game in total: [color=#FFC700]Service Station, Styling Center, Tire Service Center[/color] and [color=#FFC700]Technical Center[/color]. Each of them can be purchased as an independent profitable business.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Business commands:[br/][/color][color=#E0584B]/business [/color]- Business information[br/][color=#E0584B]/sellbiz [/color]- Sell the business to the state[br/][color=#E0584B]/bizmusic [/color]- Sound when entering the business[br/]

[color=#FFC700]Kiosks[/color] are one of the cheapest businesses. [color=#FFC700]Snack bars[/color] are a common and profitable business. In snack bars, players buy food and also complete Courier tasks, bringing the owner additional profit.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Business commands:[br/][/color][color=#E0584B]/business [/color]- Business information[br/][color=#E0584B]/sellbiz [/color]- Sell the business to the state[br/][color=#E0584B]/bizmusic [/color]- Sound when entering the business[br/]

The company offices are located in [color=#FFC700]Batyrevo urban-type settlement[/color] and [color=#FFC700]Busaevo settlement[/color].[br/][br/][color=#FFC700]For business owners:[/color][br/]Trucks for the transport company must be purchased at the truck dealership and regularly maintained and repaired.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Transport company commands:[br/][/color][color=#E0584B]/company[/color] - Company main menu[br/][color=#E0584B]/orders[/color] - Company order list[br/][color=#E0584B]/tc[/color] - Truckers' chat[br/]

[color=#FFC700]Construction companies[/color] are an important business for the development of the region.[br/]Management of construction companies and issuance of construction contracts (construction site rental) is handled in the main office located at [color=#FFC700]/gps — Construction companies.[/color][br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Construction company commands:[br/][/color][color=#E0584B]/bcompany[/color] - Construction company management menu[br/][color=#E0584B]/bc[/color] - Construction company chat[br/]

[color=#FFC700]Clothing stores[/color] are a business for those who know fashion! The business owner sells skins to players, receiving income from it.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Store commands:[br/][/color][color=#E0584B]/business [/color]- Business information[br/][color=#E0584B]/sellbiz [/color]- Sell the business to the state[br/][color=#E0584B]/bizmusic [/color]- Sound when entering the business[br/]

[color=#FFC700]Accessory stores[/color] are a business for bright personalities. In such stores, players buy various accessories (a separate type of clothing), thereby bringing profit to the business owner.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Store commands:[br/][/color][color=#E0584B]/business [/color]- Business information[br/][color=#E0584B]/sellbiz [/color]- Sell the business to the state[br/][color=#E0584B]/bizmusic [/color]- Sound when entering the business[br/]

[color=#FFC700]Taxi fleets[/color] are a business for transporting passengers and small cargo. There are [color=#FFC700]3 taxi fleets[/color] on the server, located in the city of Arzamas, the city of Horizon City, and the settlement of Batyrevo. You can find taxi fleets using [color=#FFC700]/gps — Taxi Fleets[/color].[br/][br/]The company owner can fully manage their taxi fleet:[br/]- [color=#FFC700]Purchase vehicles[/color] for the company's taxi fleet (through regular car dealerships).[br/]- [color=#FFC700]Configure ranks[/color], including their names and access to vehicles.[br/]- [color=#FFC700]Set comfort class for vehicles[/color], as well as the cost of 1 kilometer of travel for each fare.[br/]- [color=#FFC700]Purchase [/color]permanent upgrades or temporary boosts.[br/][br/][color=#FFC700]Important:[/color] completed company orders are deducted for purchasing upgrades or boosts. They can be purchased for [color=#FFC700]Black Coins.[/color][br/][br/][color=#FFC700]Taxi fleet commands:[br/][/color][color=#E0584B]/tmenu[/color] - Taxi company management menu[br/][color=#E0584B]/tc[/color] - Taxi fleet internal chat[br/][color=#E0584B]/tord[/color] - Taxi fleet order list[br/][color=#E0584B]/tuninvite[/color] - Fire a taxi fleet employee[br/][color=#E0584B]/trank[/color] - Change an employee's rank in the taxi fleet

In [color=#FFC700]car dealerships[/color], players buy different types of vehicles for soft currency: low-class cars, middle-class cars, premium-class cars, motorcycles, trucks, and water transport. Each of the 5 types has its own dealership, which can be purchased as an independent business.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Store commands:[br/][/color][color=#E0584B]/business [/color]- Business information[br/][color=#E0584B]/sellbiz [/color]- Sell the business to the state[br/][color=#E0584B]/bizmusic [/color]- Sound when entering the business[br/]

[color=#FFC700]Workshop[/color] is a business for creative people. Here, players produce accessories, skins, and even vehicles, bringing profit to the owner. To ensure high income, it is necessary to install the most modern [color=#FFC700]Workbenches[/color] — without them, customers will not be able to create high-value items.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Business commands:[br/][/color][color=#E0584B]/business [/color]- Business information[br/][color=#E0584B]/sellbiz [/color]- Sell the business to the state[br/][color=#E0584B]/bizmusic [/color]- Sound when entering the business[br/]

In [color=#FFC700]fishing stores[/color], players can buy all the necessary tackle: ([color=#FFC700]fishing rods, groundbait, lures[/color]) for catching fish. You can also bring your catch here to sell it.[br/][br/][color=#FFCC00]Business commands:[br/][/color][color=#E0584B]/business [/color]- Business information[br/][color=#E0584B]/sellbiz [/color]- Sell the business to the state[br/][color=#E0584B]/bizmusic [/color]- Sound when entering the business[br/]

[color=#FFC700]Entrepreneurship Center[/color] is an important place for every business owner. It regulates [color=#E0584B]profit percentages[/color] and makes decisions on [color=#E0584B]confiscation[/color] of a business.[br/][br/]To keep their business, the owner must maintain it. You need to come to the Center ([color=#0099CC]/gps — Important Places[/color]) and complete the list of tasks. The more tasks completed, the higher the business profit will be the next day. If the owner ignores the tasks for more than 4 days, the business will be confiscated and put up for auction.

[color=#FFC700]Linking an email address to a game account[/color] - is a type of account protection in which unique codes for password recovery will be sent to your email address.[br/] [br/]Remember that with this type of protection you will be able to [color=#FFC700]recover your password[/color] if your account is stolen.[br/][br/]We recommend enabling this type of protection for your game account and possible password recovery.[br/][br/]Enter your valid email address in the window below; a confirmation code will be sent to it.[br/] [br/]Remember that linking an email address will help recover the password to your account in case of a hack or loss of access to the account

To continue, you need to come up with and enter a 4-digit code.[br/] [br/]This security system will help protect your account if a keylogger virus gets onto your computer and intercepts keyboard input.
